verifiedApiFacts.api: Official stable158 AAR central directory / AndroidManifest.xml
verifiedApiFacts.fact: Contains arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64; declared minSdk26 and required OpenGL ES2.0. No32bit x86 native ABI. Bounded range inspection, not device compatibility proof.
minCompileSdk37, minCompileMinorSdk2; old compileSdk36 insufficient. Build SDK requirement does not raise product minSdk30. Full toolchain compatibility still pending.
Gecko internal media/socket/gpu/crash/content services exist. Single app-owned runtime is NOT a single-OS-process memory guarantee.

Built-in installed from resource://android APK directory, privileged; ensure compares extension ID/version, not content hash. HandlerThread means thread with Handler/Looper, not necessarily a new worker.

Content native messages use session-specific delegate; sender exposes actual session, extension, URL, environmentType, isTopLevel(); background sender.session=null. Content messaging requires dedicated privileged manifest permission. No public documentId/frameId in this Java sender.

UI-thread port callbacks and postMessage/disconnect. Port sender is connection metadata, not fresh navigation proof. Local disconnect implementation unregisters and shuts down dispatcher; do not wait for own onDisconnect to release local ownership. Disconnect is not proof a site network/SDK side effect was cancelled.

Active session required; onFeatures reports supported actions; play/pause/stop/seekTo/nextTrack/previousTrack are void dispatch, no per-request completion; seekTo time seconds. onPlay/onPause/onStop/onPositionState are observations, not command IDs.
System-focus interruption/resumption is separate from user play/pause; gain resumes interrupted sources. Must preserve explicit user intent and invalidate stale focus leases.
releaseSession does not close session and leaves it active. setActive(false) is visibility/memory hint and requests asynchronous state flush; priority HIGH is a hint, not survival guarantee.

State includes history/scroll/zoom/form data; treat as sensitive. flush is void asynchronous. restore overwrites saved categories, not proof of restored account authentication. fromString can return null.
Returns GeckoResult<Boolean>; false when already completed or no cancellation delegate found. Calling cancel alone is not successful cancellation.

Android registration uses shared ext-browsingData; cookieStoreId removal allows cookies/IndexedDB and selected localStorage, but rejects cache. Platform delegate only handles downloads/form/history/passwords. Host/global cache route is not a safe context fallback.

verifiedApiFacts.api: Context clear implementation and failed flags
verifiedApiFacts.fact: Java path dispatches encoded geckoViewSessionContextId; JS drops optional clear-data callback and separately fires QMS clear. Internal clear-data callback has failedFlags; pattern path skips cleaners without matching method, and network-cache cleaner resolves after void eviction submission. Callback success alone does not prove all physical cache bytes gone.

Stable source considers builtIn privileged and permits experiment_apis for privileged extensions. QMS getUsage asynchronously yields per-origin storage; pattern clear returns request with resultCode callback. Candidate APK-fixed narrow helper needs real Release validation, not public Java API support or completed cleanup proof.

asyncVisitAllStorages can visit cache entries; callback carries byte sizes and nsILoadContextInfo with originAttributes. Aggregate-only per-context payload estimates may be possible without opening pages. Global disk consumption is separate; duplicate/storage/overhead/completion semantics still require validation.

Inspected request and inherited builder expose no session/contextId selector; do not assume runtime-level fetch shares partitioned music/mail credentials. WebResponse body is an InputStream and must be closed even when ignored.

Stable scripting schema declares world MAIN/ISOLATED; content scripts otherwise isolated. Schema presence does not prove GeckoView built-in permissions, exact frame targeting, CSP/site SDK interaction work in Release.
